profile.summary: Mississippi State University Computer Science Alumni.

positions.title: Back End Software Engineer
positions.description:
SLB’s Seismic Database Management System (SDMS) team is responsible for developing and maintaining the database architecture, services, and APIs that connect to SLB’s clients and stakeholders to their Seismic data.
Tech Stack: TypeScript, Python, C++, Restful web services, Azure

• Collaborative Development – A combination of Microsoft’s Office 365 suite and GitLab is used by agile teams to develop the SDMS services and support its stakeholders.
• Cloud Technology Utilization – Services are integrated with different Azure cloud services.

positions.title: Full-Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
Cognixia’s JUMP program is a hyper-intense technical training program that gives top STEM talent from across the U.S. the equivalent of 12-18 months of industry experience. Not only do they up-skill their technical abilities, they also evolve their digital mindset to successfully adapt and utilize technology in an efficient manner so they can JUMP start their careers via deployment with Collabera clients.

– Collaborative Development – used Git CLI and GitHub under AGILE Methodology with teammates to develop a Full Stack Application
– Designed databases under principles of Normalization and ACID and SOLID patterns
– Front End Flexibility – developed Front Ends under both SPA (React) and Servlet / JSP architecture

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Capital One’s Card Documents Platform is responsible for composition and fulfillment of statements and letters across US Card and Canada within the Card Tech Line Of Business. This critical platform has strict SLAs witch focus on business intent that delivers plastic letters and statements for all of Capital One’s customer with each member being on agile delivery teams
Tech Stack: Java, SpringBoot, Restful web services, AWS

•	Collaborative Development – used GitHub with my agile delivery teammates to develop, update, and support all of the end-to-end services that are the part Letters and Statement Services.
•	Cloud Technology Utilization – Almost all services are integrated with different AWS cloud services. (ex. EC2, ECS, EMR, CloudWatch)
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Java and +1 skill

honors.title: Information Assurance Professional Certificate
honors.description:
The Information Assurance Certificate provides educational coursework in the areas
of information assurance and data security. MSU is certified as a Center of
Academic Excellence in Information Assurance (IA) by the National Security
Agency (NSA); the IA program of instruction has been certified by the Committee
on National Security Standards (CNSS) against the National Training Standard for
Information Systems Security (INFOSEC) Professionals. The curriculum for the
certificate conforms to the Federal training standards in this area. A faculty member
from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering’s Center for Computer
Security Research (CCSR) will be appointed annually to administer the program.
honors.issuer: Issued by Mississippi State University · Nov 2020

honors.title: Student Success Scholar Award
honors.description:
FALL 2018
A certificate given to less than 1% of MSU’s student body that acknowledges the
accomplishment of having zero total absences in all of their classes, every teacher
reported attendance, the student must be taking at least 12 hours, the student must be
taking at least 4 classes, and the student's semester GPA must be 2.00 (C) or higher.
honors.issuer: Issued by Mississippi State University · Jan 2019
